title: Uruguayan-Italian Grilled Tuna Skewers
description: A fusion dish that brings the flavors of Italy and Uruguay together with the freshness of the sea. These skewers are perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: Thread tuna steaks onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush both sides of the tuna with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the tuna for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
Transfer the tuna to a plate and brush with lemon juice and garlic.
Sprinkle uruguayan chimichurri over the top of the tuna.
Garnish with crispy parsley and a sprinkle of fiery red pepper flakes, if desired.
